Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's what you'll need:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki and Kailua, snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Sunscreen (high SPF recommended for Hawaii sun)
- Hiking gear (sturdy shoes, hat, water bottle for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and luau)
- Camera (to capture memories at Pearl Harbor, North Shore, etc.)
- Travel documents (ID, tickets, hotel confirmations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Rain jacket (for potential showers, especially on North Shore)
- Beach towel
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (if not renting at Hanauma Bay)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Formal attire (optional, for nicer dinners)
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Chargers for electronic devices
- Beach bag

Special Items for Specific Activities:
- June 13 (Diamond Head Hike): Good hiking shoes, hat, sunscreen, plenty of water
- June 16 (Luau): Consider bringing a light aloha shirt or dress for the occasion
- June 17 (Spa Day): Spa may provide robes, but bring personal skincare items if preferred
